bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 71
if "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_private_smoke; then result=PASS; else result=FAIL; fi
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 72
echo ROOM_PRIVATE_EDITOR_REENTRY="$result"
test "$result" = PASS || exit 73
echo ROOM_PRIVATE_EDITOR_RECOVERY=PASS
